entries.title: Distribution certificate missing from keychain
entries.root_cause: The archive requires an Apple Distribution signing certificate for the team, but its private key and certificate are absent from the runner keychain.

entries.title: Provisioning profile does not support push notifications
entries.root_cause: The selected distribution provisioning profile lacks the Push Notifications capability required by the app entitlements; the profile must be regenerated with that capability.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both archives fail during signing, but this runner has a signing certificate and the selected profile lacks a required entitlement.

entries.title: Tide formatting assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The tide label formatter returns a rounded value that disagrees with the expected decimal precision in the unit test.

entries.title: Provisioning profile lacks push entitlement
entries.root_cause: The selected distribution provisioning profile lacks the Push Notifications capability required by the app entitlements; the profile must be regenerated with that capability.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later archive on a newer runner uses a different build number and checkout path, but the same profile still lacks the required capability.
